summary: Verastem, Inc. filed a preliminary 424B5 prospectus supplement on October 13, 2026, for a follow-on offering of common stock and, to certain investors, pre-funded warrants exercisable until fully exercised at $0.0001 per share, subject to an ownership limitation. No price per share, share count, aggregate size, or premium was specified; the last reported Nasdaq price was $7.45 on October 13, 2026. Jefferies, Guggenheim Securities, and Cantor are joint book-running managers. The shelf takedown is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; watch final pricing, warrant allocation, and dilution.
